title: AutoPay Share of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Free Move-In Waiver
content:
On a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental free move-in contract, the waiver AutoPay share depends on the claimed storage unit — the storage unit whose claim the truck contract carries as its linked storage unit and its Bluegate AutoPay Authorization — the AutoPay authorization recorded for that storage agreement:

| AutoPay authorization for the claimed unit | Share of the waiver amount |
|---|---|
| No AutoPay authorization was ever given | **0.9** |
| An authorization exists but is not active | **0.95** |
| An active authorization | Whole |

## Points of reading

- "Not active" covers an authorization in any status other than active.
- Only the authorization for the claimed storage agreement is read; an authorization on another of the renter's agreements does not count for this share.
